prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized open-sea region marker. Flat app-icon geometry. A field of
three or four symmetric wave shapes — each a simple curved tilde /
rounded-M shape — stacked in rows, all in saturated palette blues
(alternating shades of navy and sky-blue between rows). No shore, no
horizon, no boundary — just stylized waves filling the icon area.
formatted_prompt: Flat app icon, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, crisp vector geometry, modern UI register. Three stacked symmetric wave shapes — each a bold rounded-M tilde curve — filling the icon field in alternating saturated cobalt blue (#0000FF) and bright sky-blue rows, evenly spaced with strong color separation. Each wave is a single clean filled shape with sharp precise edges, no outlines, no gradients, no texture. The two-tone blue pattern reads as open sea at a glance. Pure flat fills, high contrast between alternating rows, every curve identical and deliberate, fully legible at 16px.
